purpose: Prepare existing build and profile coverage inputs for integrated native startup, audio and physical controller delivery
changes: Link AudioToolbox for the new native AudioQueue implementation and qualification utility.
Build the declared pinned SDL3/libusb hardware dependency before compiling the Switch 2 adapter; its runtime path is supplied explicitly.
Recognize the recovered Input default-rumble save patch and loader GVR alpha-mask patch when new full-range oracle reports cover them.

default_rumble.effect: Write save vibration byte to 1 before original CRC computation.
default_rumble.validation: New initializer oracle executes the actual pinned DLL replacement; 1029 cases, no mismatches before final source-hash refresh.

gvr_alpha.effect: Loader GVR_Init changes the format-mask immediate from 56 to 0; alpha is enabled.
gvr_alpha.validation: New PVR oracle executes the patched source; 2400 cases, zero value mismatches, 1503 FP flag differences (partial). Deliberately removing the profile behavior is caught.

limits: This preparatory commit does not claim native boot or story progression.
Implementation and added tests are integrated in the following source commit.
Full gate is required at the coherent integration boundary; this is not a gate record.
